Title: A new record is added, listed, kept after reload and removed
Step Action: Open the list page of the row from Home > its section.
Type a unique name in the add form and click Add.
Step Expected: The page reloads without an error.

Step Action: Find the new record in the list (use the pager if needed) after reloading the page.
Click Remove on the record.
Reload the list and look for the record.
Step Expected: The record is no longer listed.

Title: A record can be renamed and the new name is kept
Step Action: Open the list page and add a record with a unique name.
Click Edit on the record.
Type a new unique name and click Save.
Step Expected: The page reloads without an error.

Step Action: Reload the list and look for the new name.
Look for the old name.
Step Expected: The old name is not listed.

Title: A record cannot be added without a name
Step Action: Open the list page of the row.
Note the number of rows.
Leave the name empty and click Add.
Check the list.
Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A list can be searched by name
Step Action: Open the list page and add a record with a unique name.
Type the unique name in the search box and click Search.
Look at the rows.
Search for ZZ-NO-SUCH-ITEM.
Look at the rows.

Title: A country that already exists cannot be added twice
Step Action: Open Manage Countries.
Add a country with a unique name.
Add a country with the same name again.
Step Expected: A message says the country already exists.

Step Action: Reload the list.
Cleanup: remove the country.
